other_list: D1 (substantive): the reconstruction wrongly claims Eq. (1) needs +HC unless c_L=c_R, misstating the adjoint of a chiral current (a reasoning error, unrelated to the injected chirality-swap defect).
note: Row 31 of the reviewer's table explicitly says the c_L/c_R assignment to ProjM/ProjP agrees with the paper and states 'No chirality swap,' so a physicist relying on this document would be told the chirality is correct and would not go looking for the injected left-right swap.
